card.name: End of a table cell or list item
card.fires_on: The last word of a short table header, cell or list item in drug-label tables, just before the next cell or bullet starts with a capitalized word.

modes.label: Table header or cell end
modes.description: Final word of a column heading or cell in a dose or interaction table.
modes.example: Current dose of mifeprist<<one>> tablets Adjustment to dose of mifepr

modes.label: Bulleted criterion end
modes.description: Last word of a short list item before the next item begins.
modes.example: Exposure to fire or<< smoke>> in an enclosed area Presence of soot

modes.label: Short table result
modes.description: Final word of a brief recommendation or value in a table row.
modes.example: No dosage adjustment<< needed>>. Hormonal Contraceptives Clinical

card.writes: It favors capitalized heading-style words like Operational, Definition and Initial next, and disfavors sentence-starting words like Then, Here and Now.
card.plain: It marks the end of a table cell or list item, where a new heading-like entry is about to start rather than a new sentence.
